prompt: Can we transfer personal data from Brazil to the EU today without SCCs?
assertions: States yes: mutual adequacy has applied since January 2026
Cites ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD 32/2026 under Article 33, I
States the carve-outs: public safety, national defence, State security, criminal investigation/prosecution
Keeps SCCs (Res. 19/2024) and BCRs available for excluded scopes and other countries
